payload.finding: Canonical inbox contains durable Guardiao proposals newer than the current Tower head. The live Tower still verifies exactly against that head, so the exact stalled stage is after PERSISTED_INBOX and before the next proven Writer Tower write/readback. Public ATLAS projection could not be independently read in this runtime.
payload.remedy: Do not write Tower bytes from the scheduled role. Let the sole unattended Writer robot consume the canonical inbox; next audit must verify a later Tower write/readback, tower-head advancement, and ATLAS projection revision.
